verdict.rationale: Navan has a built-in AI assistant (Ava/Navan Edge) that users can delegate tasks to — analyzing travel/expense spend, summarizing spend by category, comparing to policy, predicting future spend, and even booking/changing/cancelling trips with confirmation. This is a native in-product assistant, not just an external MCP integration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Ava's task delegation beyond vendor blog/marketing copy, and clearer detail on the breadth of actionable tasks (vs. just Q&A/analysis) it can perform autonomously.
